summary: Hyperion DeFi, Inc. filed an 8-K combining quarterly earnings results (Item 2.02), a conference call and investor presentation (Item 7.01), and a routine capital markets update (Item 8.01) involving the exercise of a 30-day greenshoe option by underwriter Chardan Capital Markets for 132,249 shares at ~$0.4M net proceeds. No special-situation event—acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, or forced management change—is present. This is a standard periodic earnings release with a minor at-the-market follow-on from a previously disclosed underwriting agreement.
